from scipy.optimize import least_squares
def fit(p0,model):
    f=lambda p: model(p)-sigma
    r=least_squares(f,p0,method='lm',max_nfev=20000,xtol=1e-15,ftol=1e-15,gtol=1e-15)
    return r.x, np.mean(r.fun**2)/np.var(sigma)
def m3(p):
    k=p[0]
    A=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(T),T,T**2,np.exp(-k*T),eps*np.sqrt(T)])
    cc,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma,rcond=None)
    return A@cc
def m4(p):
    k=p[0]
    A=np.column_stack([np.ones_like(T),T,np.log(T),np.exp(-k*T),np.exp(-k*T)*T, eps*np.sqrt(T)])
    cc,*_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,sigma,rcond=None)
    return A@cc
